description: Head-movement mini-game GA25, Wave 2 Group E (precision control): progressive hold ladder. Voice calls a head-down hold; hold the down position at least 20 degrees for 2, then 3, 4, 5, then 6 seconds, returning to center between levels. A down-direction calibration prompt learns which pitch sign means down. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: hold-ramp
